description: Checks an IPv4 address against IPsum, an aggregate of public blocklists: returns the number of source feeds that list it (its level, 1 to 8) and whether it is listed at all. A higher level means more feeds agree. Not listed means none of the aggregated feeds list it. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_ipsum_threat_level
title: Security Ipsum Threat Level
